title: Best keyless Instant Finish Map Kill All God mode
features:
**Quick Guide On how to use the script:**

**For Objective Automation:**

* Enable **Instant Complete All Objectives** first before anything else.
- NOTE: When it teleports you to the radio wait till the countdown timer then spam press the "Press Here" Button

**For Combat Controls:**

* Enable **Collect Items** first (optional if you don’t care about items).
* Enable **Activate All Skills**, then you can turn on the others.

After this, you can enable anything else.

**Note:** Godmode does not work with **Open All Doors** — you must choose one.
